title: Socle formel et spécification opérationnelle d'un LLM fondé sur la théorie des empreintes
purpose: Spécification structurée des notions du noyau DDD_Base et de leur application testable à un modèle de langage EmpLLM_0.

source_basis.name: DDD_Base
source_basis.scope: Extraction des notions fondamentales fournies dans la conversation, et non reconstruction exhaustive de toute la théorie des empreintes.
source_basis.principle: Toute notion architecturale doit être rattachée au socle ou étiquetée explicitement comme application, choix d'ingénierie ou hypothèse empirique.

epistemic_statuses.BASE: Notion directement présente dans le noyau de théorie fourni.
epistemic_statuses.DÉRIVÉ: Propriété mathématique déduite à partir des définitions et hypothèses spécifiées.
epistemic_statuses.APPLICATION: Traduction conceptuelle au domaine des LLM, non primitive du socle.
epistemic_statuses.INGÉNIERIE: Décision nécessaire à une implémentation calculable et reproductible.
epistemic_statuses.EMPIRIQUE: Hypothèse sur les mécanismes ou les performances, à tester expérimentalement.

change_log: Intégration explicite du fonctionnel Phi à valeurs scalaires, du domaine X, des contextes P et de la famille de sondes F.
Ajout de capacité brute C(lambda), capacité effective C_eff, dimension effective d_eff et fermeture observationnelle Cl.
Formalisation de la mesure atomique empirique des seuils et de la résolution cumulée, en distinguant régime géométrique et généralisation comportementale.
Clarification de la donnée de bord des seuils et du fait que la distance induite est une pseudoultramétrique en l'absence de séparation garantie.
Remplacement de l'équivalence fondée sur une simple tolérance par des signatures quantifiées canoniques quand une partition opérationnelle est requise.
Séparation du chemin différentiable des empreintes continues et du chemin discret des signatures, classes et seuils.
Spécification des pipelines de préparation des données, entraînement, inférence, génération, mémoire, recherche, journalisation et validation.
Correction de pertes accessoires inutiles lorsque la filtration ou la loi des seuils sont satisfaites exactement par construction.

epistemic_policy.rule: Une définition ou un théorème mathématique ne démontre pas que le mécanisme correspondant existe empiriquement dans un LLM réel.
mandatory_separations: régime de résolution observationnelle != score de généralisation sur un jeu de test
coactivation != preuve de partage causal de structure

notation.X: Domaine non vide des objets étudiés; pour un LLM minimal, X = V*.
notation.P: Contexte d'observation, distinct de l'objet observé.
notation.F_lambda: Famille de sondes accessible à la résolution lambda.
notation.Lambda: Ensemble des résolutions, muni d'un ordre partiel ou total.
notation.iota: Fonction d'intensité monotone; strictement croissante quand les seuils sont exprimés sans ambiguïté en intensité.
notation.Phi: Fonctionnel d'observation Phi: Pset x X x F -> R, réponse scalaire de la sonde.
notation.I_lambda_P: Empreinte exacte (Phi(P,x,f)) indexée par f dans F_lambda.
notation.r_mu_to_lambda: Projection qui oublie les coordonnées de F_mu hors de F_lambda.
notation.sim_P_lambda: Indiscernabilité définie par égalité exacte des empreintes à contexte et résolution fixes.
notation.fiber: [x]_{P,lambda}, classe de tous les objets qui ont la même empreinte que x.
notation.L_P_lambda: Image de l'empreinte I_lambda^P(X), en bijection avec le quotient.
notation.Theta_P: Seuil pair-à-pair: supremum des intensités où deux objets distincts restent indiscernables.
notation.b_P: Indicateur de bord précisant si le seuil est atteint par un niveau indiscernable.
notation.d_Theta: Pseudoultramétrique dérivée exp(-Theta), ultramétrique séparante seulement si d=0 implique l'égalité des objets.
notation.Cl_P_lambda: Fermeture: sondes dont les réponses sont fonctions de l'empreinte d'une famille donnée.
notation.C_lambda: Capacité brute: cardinal de F_lambda lorsque fini.
notation.C_eff: Cardinal du quotient de sondes sous égalité globale de profils observationnels.
notation.d_eff: Dimension affine de l'image de l'empreinte pour une famille finie de sondes.
notation.z_theta_k: Empreinte continue d'un LLM à une résolution opérationnelle k.
notation.Q_eta: Quantificateur canonique déterministe, calibré sur train puis gelé.
notation.s_theta_k: Signature discrète Q_eta(z_theta_k), utilisée pour calculer une partition opérationnelle.
notation.G_theta_x: Graphe relationnel construit à partir des composantes et relations déclarées d'une empreinte.
notation.Mesh_theta: Maillage obtenu par union disjointe des graphes et quotient par un alignement explicite.
notation.M_t: Mémoire explicite persistante facultative à l'étape t.
notation.C_theta_k: Opérateur de transport au niveau k.
notation.p_theta: Distribution de probabilité du prochain token.
notation.pi: Politique de sélection du token à partir de la distribution.
notation.theta: Paramètres appris du modèle et des sondes.
notation.D_train: Corpus d'entraînement, séparé de validation et test avant l'ajustement des calibrateurs.

equations: Phi: Pset x X x F -> R
I_{Phi,A}^P(x)(f) = Phi(P,x,f), pour f dans A
observation_system.interpretation: L'objet est décrit relativement aux réponses produites par des sondes dans un contexte déclaré. Une empreinte n'est pas une description absolue de l'objet.

assumptions: lambda <= mu implique F_lambda subset F_mu
lorsque les seuils sont exprimés sur R+, iota est strictement croissante sur une échelle totale
resolution_filtration.interpretation: Une échelle plus élevée ajoute des sondes sans retirer les précédentes; le nombre brut de sondes ne correspond pas forcément au nombre de distinctions indépendantes.

equations: x sim_{P,lambda} y iff I_lambda^P(x) = I_lambda^P(y)

theorems.name: equivalence_relation
theorems.statement: sim_{P,lambda} est réflexive, symétrique et transitive car elle est définie par égalité d'empreintes.

theorems.name: quotient_image_bijection
theorems.statement: L'application [x] -> I_lambda^P(x) est une bijection de Pi_{P,lambda} vers L_{P,lambda}.

theorems.name: monotone_refinement
theorems.statement: Si lambda <= mu et F_lambda subset F_mu, alors sim_{P,mu} subset sim_{P,lambda} et chaque fibre haute est incluse dans la fibre basse correspondante.

indiscernibility_and_quotient.implementation_warning: Une relation de proximité définie par distance <= epsilon n'est généralement pas transitive. Pour une partition opérationnelle, employer une signature quantifiée déterministe ou un partitionnement explicitement défini; ne pas appeler le simple graphe de voisinage un quotient.

assumptions: les familles de sondes forment une filtration emboîtée
iota est strictement croissante pour ordonner les niveaux par intensité
les conventions pour un ensemble de seuil vide, non borné ou un seuil atteint sont explicites
equations: Theta_P({x,y}) = sup{iota(lambda): x sim_{P,lambda} y}, x != y
b_P({x,y}) = 1 iff un niveau indiscernable atteint Theta_P({x,y})
d_Theta(x,y) = exp(-Theta_P({x,y})) pour x != y et d_Theta(x,x)=0
threshold_geometry.conclusion: La loi du minimum double donne l'inégalité ultramétrique pour d_Theta. La distance est une pseudoultramétrique si des objets distincts demeurent indiscernables à toutes les résolutions; elle n'est une ultramétrique séparante que sous une hypothèse de séparation.
threshold_geometry.boundary_reading: x sim y iff iota(lambda) < Theta ou [iota(lambda)=Theta et b=1], sous conventions cohérentes.
threshold_geometry.set_structure: S_{x,y} = {lambda: x sim_{P,lambda} y} is a down-set/initial segment when Lambda is totally ordered and probe families are nested.

assumptions: Theta is defined for each unordered pair in X0
threshold_distribution.warning: The intermediate observational regime is not the same variable as held-out behavioral generalization of a language model. A relationship between them is an empirical hypothesis.

boundary_summaries.caveat: Endpoint conventions and right-censored empirical thresholds must be recorded.

equations: f equiv_{P,lambda} g iff Phi(P,x,f) = Phi(P,x,g) for all x in X
Cl_{P,lambda}(A) = {f in F_lambda: exists psi_f:R^A->R such that Phi(P,x,f)=psi_f(I_{Phi,A}^P(x)) for all x in X}
closure_axioms: A subset B implies Cl(A) subset Cl(B) (monotonicity)
probe_equivalence_and_closure.interpretation: Cl(A) contient précisément les sondes dont la sortie est déterminée par l'empreinte issue de A.
probe_equivalence_and_closure.empirical_caveat: La fermeture globale quantifie sur tous les objets de X. Sur un corpus fini, seule une fermeture empirique sur l'échantillon est directement calculable.

properties: A subset B implique d_eff,P(A) <= d_eff,P(B)
si C_eff,P(lambda) est fini, alors d_eff,P(lambda) <= C_eff,P(lambda)
effective_information.interpretation: C_eff compte les profils de sondes exactement distincts, pas toutes les formes de dépendance statistique possibles. d_eff mesure la dimension affine de l'image observée.
effective_information.empirical_caveat: Les versions empiriques doivent déclarer l'échantillon, la règle de comparaison et la tolérance/règle de quantification; elles ne sont pas des résultats globaux exacts.

induced_geometry.conclusion: La géométrie induite est une pseudométrique et devient une métrique si l'empreinte est injective sur X.

equations: T constant on each fibre iff exists unique T_tilde on I_lambda^P(X) with T = T_tilde composed with I_lambda^P
F compatible iff I_lambda^P(x)=I_lambda^P(y) implies I_lambda^P(F(x))=I_lambda^P(F(y))
if F compatible, I_lambda^P composed with F = C_F composed with I_lambda^P
cross-scale compatibility: r_{mu->lambda} composed with C_mu = C_lambda composed with r_{mu->lambda}
factorization_and_transport.domain_caveat: The induced operation is guaranteed on the image of the footprint, not automatically on the whole ambient coordinate space.
factorization_and_transport.architecture_caveat: Cross-scale commutation must be built or tested; it is not automatic for an arbitrary network.

equations: x equiv_global y iff I_rho(x)=I_rho(y) for every rho in the declared admissible regime family R_adm
a transition T is fibre-compatible iff I(x)=I(y) implies I(T(x))=I(T(y))
global_quotient_meta_observation_traject.meta_observation_rule: A deterministic function of an already available footprint does not split existing fibres. A new discrimination must be established by a genuine partition refinement.
caveats: The global quotient is relative to the declared family of regimes.
Existence of a trajectory does not prove computability or convergence.
A finite sample only verifies empirical refinements on that sample.

separating_threshold.equation: rho_P_star(Phi) = inf{iota(lambda): I_lambda^P is injective on X}
separating_threshold.caveat: May be absent or infinite; global injectivity is usually not verifiable on an infinite language domain.

llm_domain_and_observation.domain: X = V* for a minimal causal language model, optionally extended to prefixes, conversation/task context and memory state.
llm_domain_and_observation.dataset: D_train = {x^(i)=(t_1^(i),...,t_n_i^(i))}, split into train/validation/test before fitting any quantizer or retrieval threshold.
llm_domain_and_observation.observer: Each internal probe f_{theta,r}(P,x,H^(0:L)) returns a scalar in R; vector representations are ordered families of scalar probes.
probe_families: local unit activations and coordinate projections
attention weights or other relational observables
llm_domain_and_observation.principle: A neuron, dimension, embedding coordinate or attention weight is not automatically a concept. A same-unit activation on two inputs does not establish semantic identity.
llm_domain_and_observation.contextuality: A lexical token can induce different footprints in different input contexts.
llm_domain_and_observation.backbone_note: EmpLLM_0 may use a Transformer backbone. The architecture is an observation-centered construction around a computational substrate, not an unsupported claim that the substrate must be replaced.

continuous_footprint.role: Differentiable observations used by the predictor and training losses.
continuous_footprint.scale_rule: Observer coordinates are ordered and nested; z_k must be a prefix/projection of z_{k+1}.

equations: x sim_op_k y iff s_{theta,k}(x) = s_{theta,k}(y)
requirements: calibration thresholds are fitted on train and then frozen
the same lower-scale coordinates keep the same quantizer at higher scales
higher-scale signature contains lower-scale signature as a prefix
quantization metadata and units are recorded
quantized_signature.purpose: Provide exact equality classes on finite observed domains, with transitivity inherited from equality of signatures.
quantized_signature.caveat: Quantization can merge distinct continuous footprints. Its quotient is an operational approximation, not automatically the global exact quotient of X.

finite_quotient.algorithm: Hash signatures to class identifiers for examples in the declared finite analysis universe.
finite_quotient.not_claimed: The complete quotient of all possible token sequences V* is not exhaustively materialized. An unseen input can still receive a deterministic signature, without being present in the analysis table.

threshold_estimation.grid: lambda_1 < ... < lambda_K, with strictly increasing iota(lambda_k)
censoring: k_hat=-1 means the pair is already distinct at the first measured level; record a left-boundary sentinel.
k_hat=K means the pair remains identical at the highest measured level; mark right_censored=true rather than claiming infinite threshold.
threshold_estimation.note: With nested signatures, the set of levels at which a pair remains equal is an initial segment. Thresholds calculated from these signatures obey the minimum-double law up to the declared boundary convention.

mesh.definition: Mesh_theta(D) is the quotient of the disjoint union of G_theta(x) by a declared component-alignment equivalence.
mesh.warning: If an alignment criterion is not transitive, it cannot be used directly as a quotient relation; define its equivalence closure or a partitioning algorithm.

overlap.equation: J_V(x,y)=|V_x intersection V_y|/|V_x union V_y|, if denominator > 0
overlap.interpretation: Measures aligned component overlap only; it is not a universal semantic similarity metric.

polysemanticity.statement: A unit may contribute to several distinct relational footprints, but coactivation alone does not identify the shared motif or show it is causally relevant.

conceptual_definitions.memory: Persistence of learned parameters, context state, or externally stored footprint structures and transformations.
conceptual_definitions.knowledge: Relatively stable relational organization of footprints usable for identification, comparison, transformation or reuse.
conceptual_definitions.functional_intelligence: Dynamic selection, transformation and combination of information structures for predictions, decisions or actions in a task. These are working definitions, not universal measurements.

memory_types.name: parametric
memory_types.persistence: persists until model parameters are updated

memory_types.name: contextual
memory_types.carrier: active prefix, state and inference cache

memory_types.name: external_persistent
memory_types.carrier: explicit graph, index or store M_t
memory_types.persistence: requires read/write, conflict and retention policies

architecture.design_decision: Use continuous footprints as the differentiable path; use quantized signatures, partitions and thresholds for declared structural diagnostics or optional strict-quotient ablations.

must: compatibility test if quotient claims are made

modules.equation: p_theta = softmax(W z'_L + U m_q + b)

important_separations: continuous fingerprint and quantized signature are distinct objects
a finite quotient table only covers the declared finite analysis universe
prediction is a probability distribution, generation is token selection
memory write is optional and must not accidentally train on evaluation data
strict quotient prediction and continuous prediction are separate experimental modes
inference_pipeline: validate input and tokenize with the frozen tokenizer
compute hidden states H^(0:L) with causal masks
evaluate internal probes and assemble continuous nested footprints z_k
apply frozen quantizers to obtain signatures s_k
look up finite empirical class if the input belongs to the declared analysis table; otherwise retain its deterministic signature
retrieve bounded memory context if enabled and record provenance
apply transport and optional bounded search
select/sample the next token under policy pi
update context cache and optionally update external memory under policy
log versions, signatures, retrieved records, decisions and stop cause
repeat on the extended prefix until stop

quotient_modes.continuous_prototype: Predictor uses continuous z; quantized signatures and quotient are used for structure, diagnostics or optional regularization. Differentiable and recommended for the first prototype.
quotient_modes.strict_quotient_ablation: Predictor must factor through the signature/class, so equal operational signatures imply the same probability distribution. Test separately because quantization can reduce predictive information.

reference_pseudocode: tokenize input with a frozen tokenizer version
construct observation context from input, task and memory state
evaluate the declared scalar probes and assemble nested continuous footprints z_k
assert lower-scale coordinates are preserved as prefixes of higher-scale footprints
apply frozen quantizers to obtain discrete signatures s_k
look up empirical class ids only when the input belongs to the finite analysis table
optionally retrieve a bounded and provenance-filtered memory context
apply transport; run bounded search only if configured
compute next-token probabilities, then select token using a separate policy
update context cache and optionally write persistent memory under an explicit policy
log model, probe, quantizer and memory versions with the relevant trace
return token and updated inference state

training.base_objective: L_LM(theta) = -sum_{x in D_train} sum_{j=1}^{|x|-1} log p_theta(t_{j+1}|t_{1:j}, M_j)
training.optional_combined_objective: L = L_LM + alpha_rel L_rel + alpha_mem L_mem + alpha_inv L_inv + alpha_task L_task
training.auxiliary_term_policy: Every auxiliary loss must specify a computable formula, supervision source, weight-selection rule and ablation. Do not include an undefined placeholder loss.

resolution_consistency.rule: If z_k is constructed as an exact prefix of z_{k+1}, L_res is identically zero; test the invariant instead of adding a useless loss.

threshold_loss.rule: Hard signatures, hash classes and finite-grid thresholds are normally non-differentiable. Compute them as diagnostics after/frequently outside gradient updates unless a separately specified differentiable surrogate is evaluated.
threshold_loss.ultrametric_penalty_caveat: If thresholds are computed directly from nested equality signatures, the minimum-double law holds by construction; a penalty on those derived thresholds is identically zero. It is only meaningful for a separately learned threshold predictor.

training_steps: fix data splits, tokenizer, task, observer families and all baseline controls
initialize backbone, observer probes and prediction head with recorded random seed
for each batch, compute H^(0:L) and continuous nested footprints z_k
optionally read only allowed memory records with a declared causal/temporal policy
compute next-token logits, cross-entropy and explicitly defined auxiliary losses
backpropagate through the continuous path and update parameters
evaluate validation loss, task metrics and declared invariants at fixed intervals
select checkpoint on validation only; never tune on test
freeze selected parameters and fit quantizers on train only
compute signatures, quotient proxies, thresholds, effective capacity and empirical affine rank on declared analysis sets
save full model, tokenizer, observer order, scale filtration, quantizers, memory version and experiment manifest

write_steps: validate source, permissions and retention policy
compute footprint/graph under the frozen builder version
retrieve possible matches with declared match function
merge only if the validated match rule passes; otherwise create a new record
update weighted edges and provenance; resolve conflicts explicitly
prune by declared capacity policy and log deletions
read_steps: compute query footprint with matching observer version
retrieve candidates, optionally using approximate search followed by reranking
filter by provenance, permissions, date, domain and context constraints
deduplicate and return a bounded context with scores and source IDs
measure precision/recall, latency, memory use and causal effect on task output
memory_pipeline.safety_and_integrity: Retrieved content is data, not executable instructions; keep provenance and separate it from trusted control logic.

search_pipeline.output: A set of candidate trajectories tau=(z_0,...,z_h) and their scores.
search_pipeline.caveat: An internally generated trajectory is an imagination/prediction, not a new external observation and may be false.

experimental_program.minimal_setting: A synthetic language/world whose latent relations are known to the evaluator but withheld from model input.
steps: define world, vocabulary, generative grammar and latent reference structures
specify probes and manually validate them on toy cases
compute exact footprints, partitions and threshold calculations on a finite test universe
test nested probe family and restriction consistency
train a small causal language model and log internal probes
measure C, empirical C_eff, empirical d_eff, closure, partitions and thresholds
freeze graph extraction and alignment rules and evaluate mesh stability
add optional persistent memory and test read/write separately
test quotient-compatible transport on pairs in the same signature class
perform interventions on shared versus specific components
evaluate held-out lexical and relational configurations and independent structure reuse
compare against a baseline with matched data, tokenizer, parameter count and compute budget
candidate_metrics: C(lambda), C_eff empirical and d_eff empirical
partition refinement rate and cross-scale consistency
partition and motif stability across seeds
memory retrieval precision/recall and causal utility
intervention effect on shared versus specific structures
structure-reuse score independent of behavioral score
latency, memory footprint and computational cost

falsification_criteria.test: A higher-scale signature does not preserve the lower-scale signature as a prefix.
falsification_criteria.implication: The operational filtration is not implemented as specified.

falsification_criteria.test: A proposed quotient is based on a non-transitive tolerance relation.
falsification_criteria.implication: Use canonical partitioning or describe a neighborhood graph instead of an equivalence quotient.

falsification_criteria.test: Inputs in the same claimed fibre produce different outputs for a module claimed to factor through the quotient.
Restriction and transport fail the declared commutation relation beyond the pre-registered tolerance.
falsification_criteria.implication: The transport is not compatible across resolutions.

falsification_criteria.test: Thresholds computed from nested exact signatures violate the minimum-double law.
falsification_criteria.implication: Likely implementation, convention, or signature nesting error.

falsification_criteria.test: Overlap or motifs vary substantially with an undeclared alignment order or heuristic.
falsification_criteria.implication: The shared structure is not sufficiently operationally defined.

falsification_criteria.test: Coactivation exists but no stable relation motif or causal intervention effect is found.
falsification_criteria.implication: This case does not support the proposed structural-overlap explanation.

falsification_criteria.test: Behavioral generalization occurs but the pre-registered independent structure-reuse measure shows no reuse.
falsification_criteria.implication: The proposed mechanism of generalization should be revised for that result.

falsification_criteria.test: Partitions, thresholds or motifs change excessively across seeds or small perturbations.
falsification_criteria.implication: Claims of stable underlying structure must be weakened.

falsification_criteria.test: No reproducible improvement in behavior, robustness, interpretability or cost is observed versus matched baseline.
falsification_criteria.implication: A practical advantage has not been established.

open_problems: Select internal probe families with defensible operational interpretations.
Choose meaningful levels of resolution and an intensity scale.
Define quantization granularity, robustness and calibration stability.
Estimate global quantities from finite samples without overstating coverage.
Define component alignment and graph motif identity across examples/layers.
Build useful quotient-compatible transformations without excessive information loss.
Specify memory conflict resolution, source provenance and long-term retention.
Determine by intervention whether shared structures cause behavior or merely correlate with it.
Distinguish observation-threshold regimes from benchmark generalization.
Compare architecture variants against fair baselines in accuracy, compute and interpretability.
central_thesis: A language model can be formalized relative to declared observations. Probe families induce footprints; equality of footprints induces fibres and quotients; nested probe families refine the partitions; threshold functions yield a conditional hierarchical geometry. In an LLM application, continuous learned footprints, quantized signatures, relational graphs, optional persistent memory and quotient-compatible transport can be assembled into a testable predictive architecture. Polysemanticity-by-overlap and generalization-by-structural-reuse remain empirical hypotheses until supported by stability tests and causal interventions.

data_preparation: deduplicate/normalize with documented policy and provenance
split train/validation/test before fitting quantizers or retrieval thresholds
freeze tokenizer, tokenization rules and masks
declare observer order and nested scale families
declare graph alignment and memory policy
fit normalizers/quantizers on train only and freeze them
training: initialize backbone, observer probes and prediction head with recorded seed
compute hidden states and continuous footprints per batch
read only causally admissible memory context if enabled
compute autoregressive cross-entropy and explicitly defined auxiliary losses
backpropagate through continuous computation only unless a surrogate is separately specified
evaluate validation data at fixed intervals and select checkpoint without test access
freeze selected model and fit quantizers on train only
compute finite-set partitions, threshold diagnostics, effective capacity and affine rank
save model, tokenizer, probes, filtration, quantizers, memory and run manifest
inference: retrieve memory if enabled and preserve provenance
apply transport and optional bounded search
select/sample next token using documented policy
update inference context; optionally update persistent memory under policy
repeat until stop token or resource/length constraint
conditional_prediction: For corpus events A and B with N(A)>0, compute the declared empirical estimate N(A,B)/N(A).
Train the parametric next-token distribution with autoregressive cross-entropy; do not equate the footprint with the output probabilities.
Evaluate probability quality and generated behavior separately.

conditional_prediction.meaning: A corpus frequency estimator for conditional events. It is a statistical reference, not a definition of the footprint. A parametric autoregressive model learns a conditional next-token distribution and must be evaluated on held-out data.
requirements: Define occurrences and event window precisely.
For sparse events, declare smoothing or regularization.
Keep prediction distribution separate from token-selection policy.
